title: Building Betopia AI’s Agentic Search Engine: From Web Search to Evidence-Grounded Research
excerpt: When you build web search for an LLM assistant, the first prototype takes an afternoon. The real engineering begins when handling multi-provider fallbacks, Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF), in-memory BM25 retrieval, and verified citation evidence pipelines.

title: Building Stateful Multi-Agent Runtimes with LangGraph and Human-in-the-Loop Safeguards
excerpt: Patterns for managing state checkpoints, deterministic tool invocations via Model Context Protocol (MCP), and asynchronous human-in-the-loop review nodes in critical workflows.

title: Optimizing vLLM PagedAttention & Continuous Batching in High-Concurrency Environments
excerpt: A deep dive into reducing P95 TTFT under 280ms on self-hosted vLLM clusters. Practical benchmarks on KV-cache memory reclamation, tensor parallelism, and quantized AWQ weights for enterprise production workloads.

title: High-Throughput Streaming in FastAPI: Server-Sent Events (SSE) for LLM Token Streams
excerpt: Architecting zero-buffering async microservices in Python 3.12, handling client disconnects, and tracking token latency with custom telemetry middleware.

title: Zero-Downtime Containerized GPU Orchestration with Docker and CUDA Runtime Isolation
excerpt: Packaging high-memory PyTorch services, isolating CUDA drivers, and orchestrating bare-metal Linux workers with automated health check fallbacks.

title: Low-Resource NLP Fine-Tuning: Parameter-Efficient LoRA on Bangla Domain Datasets
excerpt: Methods and quantitative benchmarks from our peer-reviewed IEEE research on clinical signal and low-resource multilingual tokenization under compute constraints.
